sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Sparkling Silver Anchor & Evil Eye Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Stay grounded and protected with this chic anchor and evil eye charm bracelet. A perfect high-fashion accessory for coastal-inspired looks, it keeps its brilliant silver shine best when kept dry. To preserve its luster, avoid moisture and perfumes, and store in its original packaging after use.
